description:
## Problem
BenchBox treats shannon-barrow/databricks-tpc-di as MIT on the owner's instruction, but the repository has no LICENSE file, and most of its commits come from databricks.com addresses, so the copyright holder may be Databricks. The public record should match.

## Owner decisions
- 2026-11-21: "You will consider the license to be MIT for the purposes of this effort and we will include the usual TPC caveats and limitations."
- Nothing waits on this.

## Action (owner)
Send, or adapt, this request:

> Hi Shannon. BenchBox (MIT, https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox) is basing its TPC-DI implementation on the ETL SQL in shannon-barrow/databricks-tpc-di (commit 8e0f944), with attribution. The repository has no LICENSE file. Could you add one, MIT if possible (Apache-2.0 also works), covering at least `src/incremental_batches/**` (excluding the TPC appendix files)? Could you also tell us the copyright line to use (you, Databricks, Inc., or both), and whether Databricks needs to approve?

## Decision gates
The agent does not contact the author. When the owner reports the answer, a one-line pull request corrects the copyright line in step 6's files if needed. If the answer is a refusal or a restrictive licence (for example the Databricks License, which limits use to Databricks services), stop all work that derives from the project and report.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the owner's report of the answer is quoted on this item; the copyright line in the repository matches it.
